plugins.name: zcode-loop
plugins.description: Measurement loop for ZCode: state a goal and a mechanical metric, let the agent change one thing at a time, keep what moves the number, revert what does not, and keep an auditable ledger of every trial.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 定目标与机械度量，agent 每次只改一处，跑基准、保留有效改动、回滚无效改动，并留下可审计的试验账本。
